title: feat(app-shell): Studio's app, permission and view previews show the authored area descriptions, RLS policy labels and view label (objectui#11027)
body:
Fixes #11027
Clause-②: no

Four display keys that `@objectstack/spec` parses and publishes reached no human anywhere in Studio. Each designer preview now renders its key where it was authored, and renders nothing where it was not.

## What changed

All under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`.

| key | preview | now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `app.areas[].description` | `AppPreview` | An areas list under the app header, in read and design mode: each area's `label` and `id`, with its `description` beneath it. `label` and `description` are the spec's `I18nLabel`, so both go through the spec's `resolveI18nLabel` in the designer `locale` (the resolver `DashboardPreview` already uses). |
| `permission.rowLevelSecurity[].label` | `PermissionPreview` | A policy list under the existing `perm.rls.title` heading ("Row-Level Security" / "行级安全"): each policy's `name`, with its `label` beside it. The header pill still counts them. |
| `permission.rowLevelSecurity[].description` | `PermissionPreview` | Beneath its policy's row. |
| `view` container `label` | `ViewPreview` | The preview heading (an h3 above the rendered view) on the list route, the form route and the no-object state. No one-entry tab strip. The label is `I18nLabel` and is resolved the same way. |

- An unauthored key renders nothing: no stand-in text. The area `id` and the policy `name` are required identifiers and always show, the way the headers already show the app and permission-set names.
- A permission set whose only grants are policies used to show the "grant at least one permission" empty state, which would have hidden the policies. The empty-state test now also asks whether `rowLevelSecurity` is empty.
- New chrome: one designer row, `engine.appPreview.areas` ("Areas" / "区域", matching the runtime sidebar's `sidebar.area`), in the designer table's `en` and `zh` halves. The policy list reuses `perm.rls.title`.
- Changeset: `.changeset/11027-preview-display-keys.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Premises, re-measured at origin/main `a5841be35`

- `AppPreview.tsx`: `grep -c areas` = 0, with a control of `grep -c navigation` = 8 on the same file.
- `PermissionPreview.tsx`: `rowLevelSecurity` was read into `rls` and used only for the count pill.
- `ViewPreview.tsx`: the label was relayed only into the one injected named listView. `ObjectView`'s `renderNamedViewTabs` returns null when `entries.length` is at most 1. The reverse run below measured it through the real `object-view` stack: with the fix reverted, the authored label is not a heading anywhere on the page.
- Key types: area `label` and `description` and the view item `label` are `I18nLabel`. The RLS policy `label` and `description` are plain `z.string()` in the installed spec 17.4.0 and in objectstack `origin/main` `rls.zod.ts`. So the permission pin has no locale-map case, and a non-string value renders nothing instead of being stringified.

## Evidence

The final head is `335a6c38c`. Every reading below is at that sha unless it says otherwise. Heavy runs went through the shared verify lock.

- **Build.** `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: exit 0, 28 tasks, 12 of them cached.
- **Type-check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all three new pins.
- **Tests.** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/` plus the three `packages/i18n` tests that read the designer table (`appDesigner-fieldDesigner-formula-retired-6310`, `dashboard-emptyState-keys-retired-7125`, `perm-home-namespace-3546`): **Test Files 82 passed (82), Tests 1108 passed (1108)**. The run also included one uncommitted scratch probe (1 file, 1 test; see Acceptance notes), so the committed tree accounts for 81 files and 1107 tests.
- **The pins**, one per preview:
  - `previews/AppPreview.areas-11027.test.tsx`: authored, absent (per area and per app), a locale map in `zh-CN` and `en-US`, the zh heading row, and design mode.
  - `previews/PermissionPreview.rlsPolicies-11027.test.tsx`: authored, absent (per policy and per set), a policies-only set, and the zh heading row.
  - `previews/ViewPreview.containerLabel-11027.test.tsx`: through the real `object-view` registration. Authored, absent (the heading set equals the authored set minus the label, so nothing stands in for it), a locale map in `zh-CN` and `en-US`, and the form route.
- **Reverse verification** at `0edb411f1`: the three preview sources were checked out at BASE `a5841be35` and the pins kept at head. The mutation was proven on disk before the run: each file hashed to its BASE blob, and the markers `readAreas` / `readPolicies` / `ViewLabelHeading` counted 0. Result: **11 failed, 2 passed of 13**. The 2 green cases are the two per-app and per-set absent cases, which is the expected direction. Every authored, locale-map and heading case went red. Restoration used `git checkout HEAD --`, was proven by HEAD blob hashes and an empty `git diff HEAD`, and ran from an EXIT/INT/TERM trap. The one commit after `0edb411f1` (`335a6c38c`) changes types only: it reads `draft.areas` off the already-typed draft, and it types the view pin's stub adapter. The reverse run was not repeated for it.
- **Lint, narrowed to the diff.** `pnpm exec eslint --format json` over the 7 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 7 files, **0 errors**, 29 warnings.
  - Every warning is already on `main`. Per-file warning counts, BASE to head: `AppPreview.tsx` 8 to 8, `PermissionPreview.tsx` 3 to 3, `ViewPreview.tsx` 18 to 18, `i18n.ts` 0 to 0. The three pins have 0.
  - Population: `eslint.config.js` lints `**/*.{ts,tsx}` minus its ignores (build output). The changeset `.md` is outside that population.
  - Invariance: the config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch.
  - The repo-wide `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- **Gates** (`node scripts/…`), each exit 0, each quoted by its own verdict line:
  - `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-i18n-designer-table-parity` ("Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."), `check-i18n-en-drift` (the designer table: 1 key added, 0 en values changed);
  - `check-changeset-presence` (7 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-claims` (report-only; the three pending changesets it names for `i18n.ts` were read, and all three paragraphs still hold), `check-pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-designer-field-key-parity`, `check-test-path-roots`.
- **Not measured locally:** the full `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` runs (they belong to CI), and a real browser. The previews were read through React Testing Library DOM only.

## Acceptance notes

- **Finding, class a, not in this diff.** `AppPreview` mishandles two other `I18nLabel` keys it already reads:
  - The app header prints `[object Object]` for a locale-map `label`, because it uses `String(label)`.
  - `normalizeNav` keeps a nav item's `label` only when it is a string. A childless nav item with a map label is dropped from the list, together with its target. A group with a map label reads "(unnamed)".
  - Measured by an uncommitted render probe of the Studio app preview at `335a6c38c`. A plain-string nav label on the same mount rendered, as the control.
  - Left out of this diff: the card's scope is the four unrendered keys. The next change queued on that file is objectui#10862.
  - Dedupe words: `AppPreview app label object Object` · `AppPreview navigation label locale map unnamed` · `app preview I18nLabel resolveI18nLabel nav label`.
- **Claim wording vs this repo.** The claim says a new chrome key would land in the `packages/i18n` locale packs. The designer's `engine.*` rows live in its own table (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, `en` and `zh`), which is the only table the designer `t()` reads (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out"). The new row went there, and no pack changed.
- The relay of the label into the injected listView is unchanged. It still renders nowhere on this route. Removing it is not this card's business.

Implemented by `domain:ui` seat 2 in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`, on branch `claude/issue-11027-preview-display-keys`.
